description: This file defines models and methods related to analytic journal billing rates, including classes for rate grid, account extension, timesheet extension, and invoice extension, with logic for handling billing rate lookups and updates.

classes.name: analytic_journal_rate_grid
classes.description: Relation table between journals and billing rates

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Extension of account.analytic.account with invoicing rate relations

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Extension of hr.analytic.timesheet with billing rate logic

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension of account.invoice with analytic line billing rate application

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Handles change in account_id, updates to_invoice based on billing rate grid

methods.name: on_change_journal_id
methods.description: Handles change in journal_id, updates to_invoice based on billing rate grid

methods.name: _get_analytic_lines
methods.description: Overrides to set to_invoice in analytic lines based on billing rate grid
